mission.goal: Run the proven v40 recovery canary through a resumable, corruption-detecting 24-hour soak with at least 25 hourly observations.
mission.workflow: Validate the persisted chain before every tick, suppress duplicate cycle IDs, execute one due canary, atomically persist evidence, and pass only after the 24-hour boundary with every cycle passing.
mission.data: Atomic private JSON state, atomic JSONL hash-chain ledger and a sanitized JSON receipt; no credentials, paths or raw exception text in the receipt.
mission.interface: Python 3.12 API and CLI invoked initially and then hourly by an external scheduler.
mission.stack: Python 3.12 standard library wrapping the SOVARA v40 deterministic recovery canary.
mission.environment: ChatGPT Work local runtime; scheduler and remote publication are separate bounded lanes.
mission.governance: Formation v41 action-scoped execution, documentation-first route and one local state mutation path.
mission.failure: Fail closed on state or ledger corruption, invalid IDs/timestamps, canary exception, failed assertion, partial state advance or proof-hash failure.
mission.testing: Deterministic initial, early, idempotent, 25-cycle, failed-cycle, corruption, interrupted-state and chain tests.
mission.deployment: Not externally deployed by this build; an authorized scheduler may invoke the same idempotent CLI once per hour.
mission.continuity: Ledger-first atomic persistence, state reconciliation, deterministic schedule, stable cycle IDs and terminal PASS/FAIL states.

assumptions.storage: State, ledger and receipt stay private and writable.
assumptions.authentication: Filesystem authority is inherited from the admitted local mission.
assumptions.deployment: Local test proof does not claim completion of the future 24-hour observation window.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: CLI and machine-readable receipt only.
components.backend: One-tick soak state machine wrapping run_canary().
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: atomic JSON state and JSONL ledger are the bounded persistence layer.
components.queue: One deterministic due cycle per invocation.
components.worker: External scheduler invokes the idempotent CLI; the controller performs one bounded canary.
components.scheduler: External hourly scheduler; not created or modified in this local build.
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: ledger cycle IDs provide durable duplicate suppression.
components.storage: Atomic JSON state, atomic JSONL hash chain and sanitized receipt.
components.authentication: Formation-authorized local filesystem lane; no connector credentials.

observability.correlation_ids: Soak ID, deterministic cycle ID, sequence and event SHA-256.
observability.health_checks: Full ledger validation before each tick and terminal status in the receipt.
observability.structured_logs: Canonical one-line JSON events with predecessor and event hashes.
observability.audit_logs: Immutable logical cycle records and atomic state checkpoints.
observability.metrics_alerts: Cycle, pass/fail, next-due, chain-head and failure-code fields.

testing.integration: Controller wraps the existing v40 run_canary() contract.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Twenty-five simulated hourly ticks must remain RUNNING through hour 23 and PASS at hour 24.
testing.fixtures_mocks: Temporary directories, fixed UTC start and deterministic fake canary.

deploy_commands: NOT_APPLICABLE: this patch does not create or change an external scheduler.
rollback_commands: Stop invoking the v41 controller and preserve its state, ledger and receipt for audit; v40 remains unchanged.

debugging.INVALID_INPUT: Use a timezone-aware UTC timestamp and safe stable ID.
debugging.AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE: Stop without moving or publishing state.
debugging.TIMEOUT: Retry the same cycle ID; duplicate suppression is durable.
debugging.PARTIAL_WRITE: Validate the ledger and reconcile lagging state on the next tick.
debugging.MISSING_CONFIGURATION: Pass explicit writable state, ledger and receipt paths.
debugging.EXTERNAL_API_FAILURE: The local deterministic route has no external API; scheduler failure leaves the next cycle due.

continuity.idempotency: Stable cycle IDs return the existing receipt without a second canary or ledger record.
continuity.resume_conditions: Validate the complete ledger; reconcile a state checkpoint that lags a valid ledger; run only the next due cycle.
continuity.stop_switch: Stop scheduler invocation; preserve all three state-plane files without alteration.

proof.test_results: Eight focused v41 controller tests pass; full adapter discovery passes 307/307; the real v40-wrapped initial-cycle smoke passes.
proof.deployment_readback: NOT_APPLICABLE: no external deployment is claimed.
proof.semantic_verification: Deterministic tests verify chain validation before work, duplicate suppression, ledger-first resume, fail-closed corruption and PASS only at hour 24 after 25 successful cycles.
proof.truth_boundary: This proves the controller locally. The real 24-hour soak remains RUNNING until 25 externally observed hourly cycles have passed.
